title: Breathtaking
text: Spectacular, friendly and competent staff, Omar the very good and funny driver. Unique experience, short but intense.

title: Best ride on my life💛
text: Wow The instructors are brilliant in how they do their job. I was driving a Lamborghini evo spyder which had good acceleration. The prices are ok and the cars in the store are a real wonder. I recommend everyone to go for a ride
author: GoPlaces01868737570

title: Phenomenal experience for anyone!
text: An amazing experience. We drive a Ferrari Portofino through the streets of Barcelona and up to the Olympic stadium for my father in law’s birthday. Juan Carlos was friendly, attentive and fun and made the experience all the better. We shared the driving and think it was excellent value for money. I will be doing this again next time I’m in Barcelona and would highly recommend this activity!
author: Stezjrobertson
